title: PR Gate guardrails config
description: Configuration for the PR Gate GitHub Action (guardrails.prgate.json). All project-specific behavior comes from this single file; the check is deterministic and path-based only.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this JSON Schema, for editor validation/autocomplete.

guardrails.description: The single top-level object holding all PR Gate settings.

protected.description: Glob patterns (minimatch syntax) matched against the PR's changed file paths. The config file itself is always guarded implicitly, so even an empty or omitted list still catches edits to guardrails.prgate.json.

source_of_truth.description: POST-MVP. Parsed and shape-validated, but NOT enforced in this version.

is_hard_blocker.description: false (default) = advisory comment only. true = the check fails until a write-access user applies the approval label.
